result: Platform-neutral PtyHandle interface + factory: native Tauri adapter forwards typed PtyCommands to focusa_pty_* commands and re-emits events with exact AttachmentKey/WorkSurfaceId/generation/sequence, failing closed with a typed error when the Cargo runtime is absent; honest virtual fallback for preview that never invents input acceptance or output. No ordinary child-process pipe implementation exists. One handle per governed Attachment keeps Pi alive while Mission Canvas is visible.
